cards.ex: The documentary featured hard-hitting journalism that exposed corruption at the highest levels.
cards.exUz: Hujjatli filmda yuqori darajadagi korrupsiyani fosh qilgan keskin jurnalistika namoyish etildi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy muammolarni ochib beruvchi, qattiq tanqidiy maqolalar.

cards.ex: The article presented a slanted view of the election, favoring one candidate over the others.
cards.exUz: Maqola saylovga nisbatan bir tomonlama qarashni taqdim etib, boshqa nomzodlarga nisbatan bir nomzodni qo'llab-quvvatladi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealarni xolis bo'lmagan, bir tarafni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan tarzda taqdim etish.

cards.ex: The media landscape has changed dramatically in the last decade with the rise of social media.
cards.exUz: So'nggi o'n yillikda ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning rivojlanishi bilan media muhiti keskin o'zgardi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalarining umumiy holati, ularning o'zaro ta'siri va o'rni.

cards.ex: The media plays a significant role in shaping public opinion on political issues.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari siyosiy masalalarda jamoatchilik fikrini shakllantirishda muhim rol o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning ma'lum bir mavzu bo'yicha fikrini o'zgartirishga yoki shakllantirishga ta'sir qilish.

cards.ex: The two news channels are engaged in a ratings war, trying to outdo each other with sensational stories.
cards.exUz: Ikki yangiliklar kanali sensatsion hikoyalar bilan bir-biridan o'zib ketishga harakat qilib, reytinglar urushiga kirishgan.
cards.uzDef: Telekanallar yoki radio stantsiyalari o'rtasida ko'proq tomoshabin yoki tinglovchi yig'ish uchun kurash.

cards.ex: The employees used the company forum to air their grievances about the new management.
cards.exUz: Xodimlar kompaniya forumidan yangi rahbariyat haqidagi shikoyatlarini bildirish uchun foydalanishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqchasiga norozilik yoki shikoyatlarni aytish.

cards.ex: The website relies heavily on advertising revenue to stay afloat.
cards.exUz: Veb-sayt suzib yurish uchun reklama daromadiga juda bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Reklamadan keladigan pul, reklama joylashtirishdan olingan foyda.

cards.ex: Don't buy into all the hype; do your own research.
cards.exUz: Barcha shov-shuvlarga ishonmang; o'z tadqiqotlaringizni o'tkazing.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga ishonish yoki qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Be careful what you post online; it contributes to your digital footprint.
cards.exUz: Internetda nima joylashtirayotganingizga e'tibor bering; bu sizning raqamli izingizga hissa qo'shadi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning internetdagi faoliyati qoldirgan ma'lumotlar yig'indisi.

cards.ex: I can't believe she fell for that scam email.
cards.exUz: Men uning ushbu firibgarlik elektron pochtasiga ishonib qolganiga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror yolg'onga yoki aldovga ishonib qolish.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get a handle on the new software.
cards.exUz: Menga yangi dasturni o'zlashtirish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunish yoki nazorat qilishni boshlash.

cards.ex: The scandal hit the headlines and caused a public uproar.
cards.exUz: Janjal sarlavhalarga chiqdi va jamoatchilikning noroziligiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta yangilik bo'lib, ommaviy axborot vositalarida keng tarqalish.

cards.ex: The show blends news and entertainment, making it a form of infotainment.
cards.exUz: Shou yangiliklar va ko'ngilocharlikni birlashtirib, uni axborot-ko'ngilochar shakliga aylantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Axborotni ko'ngilochar tarzda taqdim etish.

cards.ex: Due to market saturation, the company struggled to increase sales.
cards.exUz: Bozor to'yinganligi sababli, kompaniya sotuvlarni oshirishga qiynaldi.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulot yoki xizmat bozorda juda ko'p bo'lganda yuzaga keladigan holat.

cards.ex: The company used newsjacking to promote its product during the major sporting event.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yirik sport tadbiri paytida o'z mahsulotini targ'ib qilish uchun yangiliklardan foydalanishni ishlatdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z marketingi uchun mashhur yangiliklar voqealaridan foydalanish.

cards.ex: I heard on the grapevine that the company is planning layoffs.
cards.exUz: Men mish-mishlardan kompaniyaning ishdan bo'shatishni rejalashtirayotganini eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan manbalardan, mish-mishlardan xabar topish.

cards.ex: The campaign included paid media such as TV ads and online banners.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya pullik media, masalan, televizor reklamalari va onlayn bannerlarni o'z ichiga olgan.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniya tomonidan reklama uchun pul to'langan ommaviy axborot vositalari.

cards.ex: The politician was trying to push a narrative that he was the only one who could fix the economy.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi faqat u iqtisodiyotni tuzata oladi, degan hikoyani o'tkazishga harakat qilardi.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqeani yoki fikrni odamlarga singdirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Her razor-sharp wit made her a popular commentator.
cards.exUz: Uning o'tkir aqli uni mashhur sharhlovchiga aylantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda o'tkir, aniq va ta'sirchan.

cards.ex: Some people use social media to constantly seek validation from others.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan doimiy ravishda boshqalardan tasdiq izlash uchun foydalanadilar.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan o'z fikrlarini yoki harakatlarini tasdiqlashni so'rash.

cards.ex: You should take everything you read online with a grain of salt.
cards.exUz: Internetda o'qiganlaringizning hammasini shubha bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga to'liq ishonmasdan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The company uses user-generated content to promote its products on social media.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda o'z mahsulotlarini targ'ib qilish uchun foydalanuvchi tomonidan yaratilgan kontentdan foydalanadi.
cards.uzDef: Foydalanuvchilar tomonidan yaratilgan kontent, masalan, rasmlar, videolar, matnlar.

cards.ex: Several senators voiced concerns about the proposed legislation.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta senatorlar taklif qilinayotgan qonun loyihasi haqida xavotir bildirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki xavotirlar haqida ochiqchasiga gapirish.

cards.ex: Watchdog journalism plays a crucial role in holding powerful institutions accountable.
cards.exUz: Nazoratchi jurnalistika qudratli institutlarni javobgarlikka tortishda muhim rol o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Jurnalistikaning korrupsiyani, suiiste'molliklarni fosh qilishga qaratilgan turi.

cards.ex: That website has zero credibility; it publishes only conspiracy theories.
cards.exUz: Ushbu veb-saytning ishonchliligi nolga teng; u faqat fitna nazariyalarini nashr etadi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday ishonchni uyg'otmaydigan holat.

cards.ex: They managed to produce a successful film on a shoestring budget.
cards.exUz: Ular juda kam byudjet bilan muvaffaqiyatli film ishlab chiqarishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan biror ishni bajarish.

cards.ex: The speaker went off on a tangent about his childhood during the presentation.
cards.exUz: Ma'ruzachi taqdimot paytida o'zining bolaligi haqida mavzudan chetga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mavzudan uzoqlashib, boshqa narsalar haqida gapirish.

cards.ex: The scandal triggered a feeding frenzy among the news outlets.
cards.exUz: Janjal ommaviy axborot vositalari orasida qiziqish to'lqinini keltirib chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalarining bir voqeaga qizg'in qiziqishi.

cards.ex: It's hard to cut through the noise and find reliable information these days.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi kunda shovqinni yorib o'tib, ishonchli ma'lumot topish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p axborot ichidan eng muhimini aniqlash.

cards.ex: Above-the-line costs include payments to actors, directors, and writers.
cards.exUz: Asosiy byudjet xarajatlariga aktyorlar, rejissyorlar va yozuvchilarga to'lovlar kiradi.
cards.uzDef: Film yoki reklama byudjetining ijodiy qismiga ajratilgan xarajatlar.
